summary: Iteration 5 (partial): Reproduced the 6 IndexError failures in test_prosumator_docs.py. Root cause is in the TEST FILE, not the app. pytest.ini uses xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope, which sends each test class to a separate worker process. TestSizing/TestDocs therefore ran on a worker whose module-global CREATED list was empty. Fix: merged TestSizing and TestDocs into the TestImport class so they share one worker. Also guarded the session cleanup so it does nothing on a worker that created no records (previously it deleted every TEST_PROS record and could race with the other worker). Full suite result: 50 passed, 1 skipped (AI not called). The other review items were NOT independently verified in this iteration because the session ended. They were checked by code review only: client-priority Ctx.raw/CLIENT_KEYS, common_missing/missing_total in opis.py, status select minWidth 190, the hint text, and the Date comune line in DossierOpis.jsx.
